passages.0: The Outer Space treaty, formally the Treaty on Principles Governing the Activities of State in the Exploration and Use of Outer space, including the moon and other Celestial bodies, is a treaty that dictates international space law. The main objective of this treaty is to prevent nations placing nuclear or conventional weapons in orbit of earth, on the moon or on any other celestial body. passages.0: A sailing ship traditionally has at least one mast to hold up sails. These sails use the wind to move the ship. The rigging helps support the sails on the mast, all of which are attached to the superstructure of the ship; the hull. Sailing across oceans can be dangerous due to a lack of wind, which leads to being becalmed, or too much wind which may direct the ship in an undesirable direction. With the emergence of steamships in the early 19th century, vessels containing a steam engine allowed greater manoeuvrability from ships. Inevitably, steamships replaced all sailing ships. By 2006, automated sails were developed, as such advancement in hybrid ships progressed it lead the way for reinvigorating the age of sail.

The boiling frog is an anecdote used as a metaphor which describes a frog being put into boiling water. According to the story, if a frog were to be placed into already boiling water, it would jump out. However, if the frog were to be placed into cold water that was eventually brought to boil, it would not notice the danger and would be cooked to death. This story is analogous to a reluctance in noticing potential threats if they gradually appear.

Debate surrounds the appropriate use of the boiling frog story due to its inaccuracy regarding the real behaviour of frogs. Some commentators point out that while the story may be useful for metaphor, it is necessary to point out that, in reality, this does not occur. Others have likened the boiling frog to the metaphor about an ostrich with its head in the sand.

In order to deactivate the alarm, you need to follow these instructions:

• Locate the main alarm panel
• Unlock the door with the password “C1278X”
• Press the button marked “deactivate” on the main alarm panel
• Locate the alarm system battery*
• Remove the battery by pressing the button “detach”

*If you are unable to locate system battery:

• Locate the main circuit board
• Unlock the panel with the password “0X841”
• Detach the red wires marked “AC” and “Power”
• DO NOT remove any black wires
• DO NOT allow the wires to come into contact with other wires

If there are any further problems, please do not hesitate to contact the online help service.

The following instructions will help you to use the printer/scanner efficiently:

To Copy:

• Place the side of document you want to copy face-down.
• Ensure the copier lid is down.
• Press the Black button followed by the Start button for a black and white copy.

To Scan:

• Place the document you wish to scan face-down, as you would if you were making a photocopy.
• Use the arrow console to navigate to the ‘Scan’ option.
• Press the black button to confirm your selection choices.

Cleaning printheads:

• Use the arrow console to highlight ‘Maintenance.’ Press the black button to confirm.
• Navigate to and select ‘Colour management.’
• Follow the on-screen instructions.

N.B. If you are still seeing streaks in your print outs, consider replacing the printheads. See section 3.4 for more information.
